description: This file defines the ViewAjax class, a subclass of SugarView, specific to SuiteCRM, which configures display options for an AJAX view and acts as part of the MVC architecture.

classes.name: ViewAjax
classes.description: A class that extends SugarView to provide a specialized AJAX view with specific display options hidden.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ViewAjax object and configures display options related to title, header, footer, javascript, subpanels, and search.
